evaluate_model_fitting_error: evaluate the MHR or SMPL model fitting error by computing average vertex distance between generated and target vertices in batches
create_chunked_sequence: create a ChunkedSequence to manage chunked processing of a frame sequence with configurable overlapping boundaries between chunks
load_surface_mapping: load precomputed surface mapping data including triangle IDs and barycentric coordinates for SMPL to MHR mesh topology conversion
compute_vertex_loss: compute a weighted L2 vertex loss between predicted and target vertices with optional vertex weights and masking support
compute_edge_loss: compute an L1 edge loss between predicted and target edge vectors for robust outlier-resistant mesh fitting evaluation
